main-page.projects-intro: Synced automatically from GitHub – a selection of my own tools, simulations, and side experiments.
main-page.skills-intro: From the code down to the infrastructure underneath – the technologies I work with day to day.
main-page.about-me-p1: IT and software development have fascinated me for years. I currently work as a software developer with a focus on IT security, developing custom solutions tailored to each client's individual requirements.
main-page.about-me-p2: I also support information security officers (ISOs), coordinate documents and forms, and independently build internal tools that make it easier for teams to work together. I'm always looking to keep growing my technical skills along the way.
main-page.about-me-p3: Alongside my job, I build my own projects – from web applications and bots to setting up and running self-hosted server infrastructure. In my home lab I plan, operate, and automate server services, including my own VPN setups, Docker deployments, and game servers, deepening what I learn in practice.
main-page.blog-intro: Selected projects and experiences that only tell half their story on GitHub: the tech, the decisions and the pitfalls.
main-page.blog-post-1-title: Self-Hosted Minecraft Server: Docker, VPN & Backups
main-page.blog-post-1-desc: A private Minecraft server on my own hardware, either Paper-optimized or as a custom modpack. Runs in Docker, with secured access plus RAID-1 and cron backups.
main-page.blog-post-2-title: Discord Bot for Events & Community Management
main-page.blog-post-2-desc: A custom-built Discord bot in Python that combines four bots in one: event management for MMOs, translation, admin tools, and a news bot. Runs in Docker.
main-page.blog-post-3-title: OxidPanel: Dashboard for My Home Server
main-page.blog-post-3-desc: A custom dashboard with live system stats, a news aggregator for IT security and a media library with adaptive HLS streaming. FastAPI backend, Vue 3 frontend, all in one Docker container.
main-page.blog-post-4-title: Game Jam: AI Companion in 72 Hours
main-page.blog-post-4-desc: At Wowie Jam 4.0 I built a game with Godot in a team of four. As one of two programmers I developed the AI companion, a forest creature that evolves into a melee or ranged fighter depending on the player's choices.
